routes.name: Downtown Heritage Walk
routes.description: Explore the cathedral, civic landmarks, and ancestral houses of downtown San Fernando. Follow the listed stop order at your own pace.

routes.name: Sto. Niño / Capitol Heritage Route
routes.description: Visit the provincial capitol area and nearby heritage landmarks. Stops are a curated sequence, not a navigation route.

routes.name: Cultural Heritage Route
routes.description: Discover cultural and religious heritage across San Fernando, including Calulut. Arrange your own transport between stops.
stops: City of San Fernando Giant Lantern and Tourist Information Center
Heritage Parochial Church, Complex of San Vicente Ferrer
